currentRepair.evidence: Fresh proper native-document execution passed all four original exact assertions without Number Field edits in this batch. Supersedes historical native2passed/2failed scrub10vs651 result; ordinary iframe pointer-lock capability remains separately classified. Missing/partial source comparison rows remain unchanged.

method: Manual body comparison, including assertions, interaction order, parameters and predicates. No title-only coverage credit. Existing dirty tests retained. Source metadata is not execution evidence.
inheritance: Each row inherits sourcePath, lane and predicates from its file. Optional final object overrides lane/predicates. Target IDs resolve to exact target path/title below. An empty target list is an explicit coverage gap, not a skipped test. Parameters inside a single source body's loops are enumerated in expandedParameters; it.each registrations have separate rows.

adaptation.react: Owned JSX factories, live renderProps/setProps and createSignal replace React render/rerender/useState. Native input events replace React synthetic change for textbox editing; hidden native change remains change. No act added.

adaptation.platform: iOS and Gecko source suites mock policy; distinguish these from physical device/engine qualification.
